title: ABBA Human Coordination and Authority Boundary
rules: ABBA may request human input but cannot fabricate human input.
Clarification requests block consequential action until resolved when ambiguity affects execution.
Consent is explicit, scoped and time-bound; lack of consent is not consent.
Human authorization is evidence presented to the authority gate, not authority manufactured by ABBA.
Declined or expired requests remain auditable and reconstructable.
Human decisions are distinct from ABBA recommendations.
Notifications do not imply acknowledgement or consent.
Escalation does not transfer authority to ABBA.
